description: Live routing-mode acceptance (plan L1-L7, L10): interactive Claude Code sessions in agterm with the router loaded from a --plugin-dir copy, an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (claude.ai Max login), the Jev classifier, and a throwaway two-file Python project. Numbers from the store's usage records and the `router decision` debug lines. Dollars are list-price estimates of the measured tokens (the session bills a plan, not credits). No session ids or paths.
task: 5 turns, the same prompts in every mode, each mode in a new session: read the two files; add divide() with a ValueError on zero plus tests; run the tests with uv and fix failures; review the change for edge cases without edits; add tests for those edge cases and rerun. Each run started from the same files. A model-initiated test command before the run turn was declined in every mode.

decisions: medium 86% >= 85%, streak short -> upgrade-pending, Sonnet 5.5 medium

findings: One run per mode: the classifier's turn-1 micro confidence differed between runs (92%, 74%, 79%), so part of the gap on turn 1 is classifier variance, not the mode.
Quality ran the same model as balanced; its list price per token is the same, and its extra cost came from 34% more output tokens (5332 vs 3986).
Cost paid $0.0685 of its $0.1662 in cache writes for the move to Sonnet; a longer session spreads that write over more turns.
The `router decision` line logs the turn-start decision; a later activity move inside the turn (low docs on Haiku, then code on Sonnet) shows in the usage cells only.

checks.L1: band `cost (profile)` / `quality (profile)` / `balanced (default)`; footer `cost mode (profile)`, none in balanced; Now tab `Mode  cost (profile)`
checks.L2: `/router mode cost` mid-session: no abort, `cost (session)` from the next turn; the continuation turn was `downgrade-held` (band: down after a passed check); after the passed check the next turn moved to low
checks.L3: project `quality` beat profile `cost` (`quality (project)`); `/router mode balanced` beat it (`balanced (session)`); `/router mode default` returned to `quality (project)`; `{"mode":"fast"}` was ignored: `cost (profile)` and the Now tab notice `Ignored: project .claude/router.json mode must be one of cost, balanced, quality`
checks.L5: `/router pin high` in cost mode ran Opus 5.5 xhigh (base route), reason `pinned`; the usage cell is `balanced|none|high|claude-opus-5-5@xhigh`; the next turn was back on cost routes
checks.L6: usage record version 2 with `cost|…`, `quality|…` and `balanced|…` cells; debug lines `router decision {mode, modeSource, classified, tier, reason, route, pinned}`
checks.L7: band, Now and Policy layouts match docs/router-band.svg, router-pane-now.svg and router-pane-policy.svg (segment order, Mode line placement, `▾ saved at once`)
